name: InterleaveRope

y.description: Output with interleave RoPE applied, same shape and dtype as input

description: Interleave-style Rotary Position Embedding. torch_npu.npu_interleave_rope(x, cos, sin) applies rotary transform with interleave pattern (even/odd index rotation). Pure PyTorch: x1=x[...,0::2], x2=x[...,1::2], stack(-x2,x1) and flatten.
